sql:
SELECT COUNT(*)
FROM schools
WHERE Virtual = 'F'
AND NCESSchool IN (
    SELECT NCESSchool
    FROM satscores
    GROUP BY NCESSchool
    HAVING AVG(AvgScrMath) > 400
);

SELECT COUNT(*)
FROM schools
WHERE Virtual = 'F'
AND NCESSchool IN (
    SELECT NCESSchool
    FROM satscores
    GROUP BY NCESSchool
    HAVING AVG(AvgScrMath) > 400
);

SELECT COUNT(*)
FROM schools s
JOIN satscores ss ON s.CDSCode = ss.cds
WHERE s.Virtual = 'F' AND ss.AvgScrMath > 400;

SELECT COUNT(s.CDSCode)
FROM schools s
JOIN satscores sa ON s.CDSCode = sa.cds
WHERE sa.AvgScrMath > 400 AND s.Virtual = 'V';

SELECT COUNT(s.CDSCode)
FROM schools s
JOIN satscores st ON s.CDSCode = SUBSTR(st.cds, 3)
WHERE st.AvgScrMath > 400 AND s.Virtual = 'V';

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT s.CDSCode)
FROM schools s
JOIN satscores sa ON s.CDSCode = sa.cds AND s.School = sa.sname
WHERE sa.AvgScrMath > 400 AND s.Virtual = 'V';

SELECT COUNT(*)
FROM schools s
JOIN satscores ss ON s.CDSCode = ss.cds
WHERE s.Virtual = 'P'
AND ss.AvgScrMath > 400;

SELECT COUNT(*)
FROM schools s
JOIN frpm f ON s.CDSCode = f.CDSCode
JOIN satscores sa ON s.CDSCode = sa.cds
WHERE s.Virtual = 'P'
AND sa.AvgScrMath > 400;

SELECT COUNT(*)
FROM schools s
JOIN satscores ss ON s.CDSCode = ss.cds
WHERE s.Virtual = 'F'
AND ss.AvgScrMath > 400;

SELECT COUNT(*)
FROM schools s
JOIN satscores ss ON s.CDSCode = ss.cds
WHERE s.Virtual = 'F'
AND ss.AvgScrMath > 400;

SELECT COUNT(*)
FROM schools s
JOIN satscores ss ON s.CDSCode = ss.cds
WHERE s.Virtual = 'F'
AND ss.AvgScrMath > 400;

SELECT COUNT(*)
FROM schools s
JOIN satscores ss ON s.CDSCode = ss.cds
WHERE s.Virtual = 'P'
GROUP BY s.School
HAVING AVG(ss.AvgScrMath) > 400;

SELECT COUNT(*)
FROM schools s
JOIN satscores ss ON s.CDSCode = ss.cds
WHERE s.Virtual = 'P'
AND AVG(ss.AvgScrMath) > 400;

SELECT COUNT(s.CDSCode)
FROM schools s
JOIN satscores sa ON s.CDSCode = sa.cds
WHERE s.Virtual = 'P'
GROUP BY s.CDSCode
HAVING AVG(sa.AvgScrMath) > 400;

SELECT COUNT(*)
FROM schools s
JOIN satscores ss ON s.CDSCode = ss.cds
WHERE AVG(ss.AvgScrMath) > 400 AND s.Virtual = 'P';
